item.title: AstraZeneca strengthens China ties with planned $15B investment
item.description: AstraZeneca’s investment will “span the value chain” of drug research and development and comes amid a prolonged surge in dealmaking activity involving large pharmaceutical companies and their counterparts in China.

item.title: Sanofi expects vaccine sales growth to dip amid ‘challenging environment’
item.description: On a conference call, executives cited “confusion” and declining vaccination rates in the U.S. while discussing a quarterly sales decline and anticipated slower growth in 2026.

item.title: The biopharma industry outlook on 2026: Optimism and tension
item.description: A spike in M&A activity and stock prices have pulled biotech out of a yearslong downturn. But regulatory tumult and fierce competition from China could short-circuit the sector's resurgence.

item.title: Politicization runs deeper than ever at FDA, risking long-term impacts
item.description: A massive overhaul of staffing and review processes have left the agency appearing heavily driven by the Trump administration’s political agenda, according to an economist and public policy expert.

item.title: AstraZeneca leans into obesity, striking wide-ranging alliance with China’s CSPC
item.description: The deal, which involves up to eight “next-generation” weight loss medications and could be worth more than $18 billion, ranks as the largest licensing pact of its kind since the start of 2025, according to BioPharma Dive data.

item.title: Amgen gives up on its once-prized eczema drug
item.description: The decision comes more than a year after disappointing initial Phase 3 results and casts further doubt on a class of autoimmune drugs thought to be challengers to treatments like Dupixent.

item.title: Building a robust in-process testing plan for cell therapy manufacturing success
item.description: The roadmap to reliable in‑process testing for cell therapy success.

item.title: GSK walks away from pioneering Wave RNA editing drug
item.description: Wave claimed GSK is handing back rights to the frontrunning program not because of questions about its potential, but because Wave is better suited to quickly advance a rare disease therapy.

item.title: Sanofi drug, inherited from Genzyme, goes 1-for-2 in rare disease trials
item.description: The drug, which has suffered multiple setbacks over the years, could finally reach the market as a treatment for a form of Gaucher disease.

item.title: Novo combination obesity shot meets goal in diabetes trial
item.description: CagriSema’s blood sugar and weight reductions exceeded the company’s blockbuster Wegovy, yet the drug might still struggle to rival Lilly's Zepbound.
